support.faq.title: Help Center
support.faq.subtitle: Search common questions or contact us if you still need help.
support.faq.item.signIn.question: How do I sign in?
support.faq.item.signIn.answer: Use Google, Kakao, or email login. If you forgot your password, use the reset link on the login screen.
support.faq.item.analysisFailure.questio: What should I do if analysis fails?
support.faq.item.analysisFailure.answer: Check your connection and try again. If the issue continues, contact support and include a screenshot.
support.faq.item.reportWrongResult.quest: How do I report a wrong result?
support.faq.item.reportWrongResult.answe: Open Contact Support and share the result details, the food name, and what should be corrected.
support.faq.item.editHealthProfile.quest: How do I change my health profile?
support.faq.item.editHealthProfile.answe: Go to Profile and update your allergens, restrictions, or traveler card language.
support.faq.item.deleteData.question: What is the difference between deleting data and deleting my account?
support.faq.item.deleteData.answer: Delete My Data removes stored profile and history. Delete Account removes the account and signs you out.
support.faq.item.languageSetting.questio: How do I change the app language?
support.faq.item.languageSetting.answer: Open Profile or app settings and change the language preference to update the UI language.
